summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] prepares a deceptive defence when [[character:ernesto-medeiros]]'s [[organization:brazilian-empire]] vessel arrives ahead of schedule. His decoys and improvised [[technology:ship-busters]] destroy the [[vessel:serra-do-mar]], but damage to [[vessel:heaven-1]]'s radiator cuts its reactor output. Reviewing the wreck, Bob concludes that further hostile replicants may exist and decides to accelerate the creation and arming of Bobs.

introducing.name: endocrine control system
introducing.description: A control system [[character:bob-replicant]] can activate to shift his emotional state toward calm purpose.

introducing.name: ship-busters
introducing.description: Improvised attack units carrying small reactors, oversized SURGE drives, [[technology:ami]] pilots, and dense metal projectiles instead of explosive warheads. They can intercept missiles or strike vessels at very high acceleration.

introducing.name: Major Ernesto Medeiros
introducing.description: A major of the [[organization:brazilian-empire]] and the replicant commanding its ship, the [[vessel:serra-do-mar]], which follows [[character:bob-replicant]] to [[location:epsilon-eridani]] to attack him. He calls serving the Empire his only priority and treats the earlier downing of an Empire vessel in the [[location:solar-system]] as the start of war.
introducing.current_state: [[character:bob-replicant]] concludes that he is gone after the destruction of the [[vessel:serra-do-mar]].

introducing.name: Serra do Mar
introducing.current_state: Disabled and tumbling after its reactor containment is destroyed.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]] after destroying the [[vessel:serra-do-mar]], Bob assesses its wreck and plans to accelerate the creation and arming of Bobs.
At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], a damaged radiator has cut reactor output by half while [[technology:roamers]] work on a patch.
